svg.title: Before and after: removing billing from a support-bot prompt
svg.desc: Before: the agent asked to remove billing wrote "Do not discuss billing, invoices, refunds, or subscription changes", naming billing four ways. After: that line is deleted and only the login-flow scope remains.
